card.statement:
Assume $C$ is a projective curve. Let $\lambda\in\mathbf{Y}$, $\nu\in\mathbf{Y}_{\succeq 0}$, and $\Gamma\in\mathfrak{P}(\nu)$. For any $\mathbb{F}$ -point $x$ of ${}_{\Gamma}\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}^{\lambda}_{B}$, there exists a separated $\mathbb{F}$ -scheme of finite type $Y$, $\mathbb{F}$ -points $y$ of $Y$ and $z$ of ${}_{\Gamma}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\nu}$, and smooth morphisms

$\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}^{\lambda}_{B}\leftarrow Y\to\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\nu}$

sending $y$ to $x$ and $z$ respectively.
card.label: Lemma 5.5

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
